title: SFO–YVR: Camille Roux
notice: Source-reviewed against Canadian government publications on 2026-10-25. Passenger and document data are fictional; no independent human review is claimed.

review.notes: Checked the authored evidence path, exceptions and disposition against ca-eta-nationals, ca-eta-link. See docs/content-review-2026-10-25.md. This is an agent source review, not independent human or immigration-authority approval.

assumptions: Adult passenger on the direct commercial SFO–YVR flight; ordinary genuine documents, matching identity, and all non-document airline checks are stipulated satisfied. No decision here guarantees admission at the Canadian border.

Only the declared citizenship and residence status apply. No unmentioned second passport, US/Canadian permanent-resident status, diplomatic exception, or other travel-permission exception is available.
Passenger names and document numbers are synthetic. Electronic authorization results are simulated carrier checks, never live calls and never a requirement to carry an eTA printout.
clues: The traveller presents an ordinary French passport and says the eTA was approved for it. The simulated carrier status check has not yet been run.

questions.label: Check eTA status for this passport
questions.response: Simulated carrier check: approved eTA found, valid for the presented passport.

questions.label: Ask about residence status
questions.response: I am not a US or Canadian permanent resident.

rationale: Run the offered electronic check before acceptance. Its result confirms the approved eTA matches the presented passport; merely possessing an undisplayed approval claim is insufficient evidence in this case.
